svg.text: OXYGEN · SCENE GENERATION · SG.4 · REVIEW BOARD
Layer rule: source clouds → precipitation beneath them → topmost temperature/data; catalog values remain the source of truth.
Cell edge is illustrative, not event time.

text.tspan: Preserve amount and rate as separate
facts and keep the original interval.

svg.text: Never extend art beyond the interval.

text.tspan: for display; keep its source time.
A leading gap shows daily facts.

svg.text: No new hourly source fact is made.

text.tspan: Do not create rain/snow art or use

svg.text: Zero does not select a condition.
Example: supplied CLEAR → RAIN → absent 11:00 hour carrying 10:00 RAIN → supplied CLEAR. Display boundaries do not assert onset or clearing minutes.
Keep each supplied CLEAR / PARTLY_CLOUDY / CLOUDY label; draw no falling precipitation.
An interior absent hour carries the prior display with its source time. A leading gap shows daily facts only.
Scene changes remain deterministic at the selected instant. Readable probability, amount, source time and missingness stay visible in text.
All precipitation falls beneath visible source clouds. RAIN has full cloud cover; Light Rain has a few clouds. Reduced motion holds the scene still.
